title: Giants' Malik Nabers 'trending in the right direction,' but won't disclose status for Week 1 vs. Cowboys

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants' Malik Nabers 'trending in the right direction,' but won't disclose status for Week 1 vs. Cowboys
sources.description: Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers was once again a full participant in Thursday’s practice, but according to Nabers, his status for Sunday’s season opener against the Dallas Cowboys is still up in the air.
